doc: The model's options apply without any in the trace: a signal queue of 1, at most 2 microsteps per call.

steps.doc: Two microsteps: e2 takes A to C and queues s1, s1 takes C to D. g is false, so D stays.
With g true, D -> A would be a third microstep: more than options.maxMicrosteps.
A -> B emits s1 and s2; the second does not fit into options.signalQueue = 1.
